name: decision-agent-kit
description: Decision-model checks for coding sessions, starting with a check that a finished turn is really finished. Uses SubQ Snap.

stopCheck.title: Stop check
stopCheck.description: off: never runs. shadow: records what it would say and shows nothing. on: shows a note under a reply it flags.

apiKey.title: SubQ API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use SUBQ_API_KEY or the key command.

apiKeyCommand.title: Key command
apiKeyCommand.description: A command that prints the SubQ API key, run without a shell when no key is set, such as a password manager's read command.

disabledPaths.title: Disabled directories
disabledPaths.description: Comma-separated absolute paths. A session started under one sends nothing to SubQ.

claimThreshold.title: Claim threshold
claimThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a reply counts as claiming the change works.

unfinishedThreshold.title: Unfinished threshold
unfinishedThreshold.description: Probability at or above which a reply counts as leaving requested work undone.

model.title: SubQ model
model.description: The decision model ID. Thresholds are tuned against the default.
